provenance.source_content_scope: Tracked code, native workflows, configuration and LICENSE; excludes tests, docs, generated SBOM and licence bundle.
provenance.scope: All installed Python distributions, with project runtime/development/build closures and environment-only packages. Native libraries embedded in wheels, OS packages, CUDA, isolated build environments and external tools are not independently inventoried. Licence files supplied by wheels are retained.
provenance.extras_scope: Project-declared extras are resolved. Extra selections for unrelated installed tools cannot be inferred from installed metadata.
